### Jerrick — Penguin Flipper Length by Sex

```{r}
penguins_fix = penguins |> 
  filter(!is.na(sex))
penguins_fix |> ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = sex)) + geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin flipper length by Sex",
    x = "Penguin Sex",
    y = "Flipper Length (mm)"
  )

```
